burst: the final state record, 3 passes, then kept in the carousel
beacon ENDED, or verified state with status = 1
delete all documents received in this gathering [FR-DATA-01, FR-DATA-06]
write the gathering memory from the last verified setlist [FR-DATA-03]

[back in range within the 60 s window]
5 min without the gathering → treated as ended;
during the 60 s: reject every GATT write with 0x88 "gathering has ended" [8.3, 10.10]
summary screen: name, date, time sung, songs sung,
write the leader's gathering memory with the participant count;
discard requests, the gathering's setlist copy, connection data [FR-DATA-03, FR-DATA-06]
stop the beacon, all data sets and the extended set
stop the GATT server; delete the key pair (pk/sk, ek), the singer table,
tokens and the resume data [10.10, FR-DATA-08]
A photographed QR code is useless from now on:
the key it names no longer exists [6.5].
